Bowlers 60 and up bowl $1 per game in the middle of the week, when the lanes are quiet. Shoe rental is $4.50 and is not part of the deal. 15% off for active duty military, veterans, and military families. Valid military ID required at purchase. Spark turns the whole lane into a projection surface. services.name: Studio Rental
services.desc: All services below can be added to any studio booking to enhance your production and final deliverables. Add livestreaming to your session and broadcast directly to YouTube, Facebook, or a private link. Includes basic stream setup and monitoring. Professional operator to run your camera, manage framing, exposure, focus, and maintain clean, consistent shots. Professional operator to execute live switching, seamlessly cutting between camera feeds, graphics, and media while maintaining smooth transitions, visual consistency, and broadcast-quality

services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: A certified trainer, a plan built around your goal, and someone who notices whether you turned up. Training built around one person, rather than a plan you found online and hoped applied to you. It starts with a fitness assessment, so your trainer knows where you are before writing anything. From there the plan is built around one goal, your schedule and any injury history you bring with you, and it changes as you progress rather than staying the same sheet every month. Rates are confirmed at the front desk. Training is open to members and non members

services.name: Massage Therapy
services.desc: Hands-on muscle work that helps you move well, sleep better and come back stronger for the next session. Every appointment opens with a short conversation about where you feel tight, how you have been training, and what you want from the hour. Your therapist works from there and adjusts pressure as they go, so the session matches the body you walked in with that day. Come for recovery between hard training weeks, for a shoulder that has been talking to you for months, or simply for an hour of quiet. Call the club or ask at the front desk and we will match you with a massage

The Co-Motion space next door gives the party somewhere to sit, eat, and open presents. Skip the planning. Our event coordinators put the whole thing together with you, from timing and setup to food, with packages that fit the budget you bring
